newsitem.title: USA: Northfield says to build plant in Waukegan, Ill.
newsitem.headline: Northfield says to build plant in Waukegan, Ill.

text.p: Northfield Laboratories Inc said Thursday it has chosen a site in Waukegan Ill., for a $43-million plant to produce PolyHeme, the blood substitute it is developing.
The Evanston, Ill.-based company said it continues to expect to break ground on the plant this fall.

At a briefing here with reporters, Northfield also said it is still hoping to find a marketing partner for PolyHeme, which is beginning U.S. Food and Drug Administration Phase III clinical trials for use in elective surgery.
"We continue to speak with a variety of parties," said president Dr. Steven Gould.
